questions.question: নির্ণয়কের সাহায্যে AX = D এর সমাধান কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,

$A=\left[\begin{array}{ccc}3 & 2 & 3 \\ 4 & 2 & 1 \\ 2 & 1 & -2\end{array}\right], \quad x=\left[\begin{array}{l}x \\ y \\ z\end{array}\right], D=\left[\begin{array}{c}5 \\ 10 \\ 15\end{array}\right]$

$\mathrm{AX}=\left[\begin{array}{ccr}3 & 2 & 3 \\4 & 2 & 1 \\2 & 1 & -2\end{array}\right]\left[\begin{array}{l}\mathrm{x} \\\mathrm{y} \\\mathrm{z}\end{array}\right] $

$=\left[\begin{array}{c}3 \mathrm{x}+2 \mathrm{y}+3 \mathrm{z} \\4 \mathrm{x}+2 \mathrm{y}+\mathrm{z} \\2 \mathrm{x}+\mathrm{y}-2 \mathrm{z}\end{array}\right] $

Ax = D হলে,

$ {\left[\begin{array}{c}3 \mathrm{x}+2 \mathrm{y}+3 \mathrm{z} \\4 \mathrm{x}+2 \mathrm{y}+\mathrm{z} \\2 \mathrm{x}+\mathrm{y}-2 \mathrm{z}\end{array}\right]=\left[\begin{array}{c}5 \\10 \\15\end{array}\right]}$

এখন,

$\begin{aligned} & D=\left|\begin{array}{ccc}3 & 2 & 3 \\ 4 & 2 & 1 \\ 2 & 1 & -2\end{array}\right| \\ & =3(-4-1)-2(-8-2)+3(4-4) \\ & D x=\left[\begin{array}{ccc}5 & 2 & 3 \\ 10 & 2 & 1 \\ 15 & 1 & -2\end{array}\right] \\ & =5(-4-1)-2(-20-15)+3(10-30) \\ & =-25+70-60 \\ & =-15 \\ & D y=\left[\begin{array}{ccc}3 & 5 & 3 \\ 4 & 10 & 1 \\ 2 & 15 & -2\end{array}\right] \\ & =3(-20-15)-5(-8-2)+3(60-20) \\ & =-105+50+120 \\ & =65 \\ & \left.D z=\mid \begin{array}{lll}3 & 2 & 5 \\ 4 & 2 & 10 \\ 2 & 1 & 15\end{array}\right] \\ & =3(30-10)-2(60-20)+5(9-4) \\ & =60-80 \\ & =-20\end{aligned}$

$\begin{aligned} & x=\frac{D x}{D}=\frac{-15}{5} \\ & =-3 \\ & y=\frac{D y}{D}=\frac{6 \tau_2}{5} \\ & =13 \\ & z=\frac{D z}{D}=\frac{-20}{5} \\ & =-4\end{aligned}$

questions.question: AM রেখাটি x-অক্ষ দ্বারা যে অনুপাতে অন্তর্বিভক্ত হয়, তা নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,

$A(-2,-6) 3 M(4,3)$ দুটি বিন্দু।

ধরি, $\mathrm{Am}$ রেখা $\mathrm{X}$ অক্ষকে $\mathrm{m}_1: \mathrm{m}_2$ অনুপাতে অন্তবিভক্ত করে।

x অক্ষের ছেদবিন্দু $P(\alpha, 0)$

AM রেখার অন্তবির্ভক্ত,

$(\alpha, 0)=\left(\frac{4 \mathrm{~m}_1+(-2) \mathrm{m}_2}{\mathrm{~m}_1+\mathrm{m}_2}, \frac{3 \mathrm{~m}_1+(-6) \mathrm{m}_2}{\mathrm{~m}_1+\mathrm{m}_2}\right)$

অর্থাৎ,

$\frac{3 m_1-6 m_2}{m_1+m_2}=0 $

$\Rightarrow 3 m_1-6 m_2=0 $

$\Rightarrow 3 m_1=6 m_2 $

$\Rightarrow \frac{m_1}{m_2}=\frac{6}{3} $

$\therefore m_1: m_2=2: 1$

AM রেখার ছেদবিন্দু 2:1

questions.question: B (6, 6) বিন্দু হতে AC সরলরেখার লম্বদূরত্ব নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
B বিন্দু হতে AC সরলরেখা লম্বদূরত্ব নির্ণয় কর।

দেওয়া আছে,

$A(-2,-6),(-6,-2)$

AC রেখার ঢাল, $m=\frac{-2+6}{-6+2}=\frac{4}{-4}=-1$

AC রেখার সমীকরণ,

$\mathrm{y}-\mathrm{y}_1=\mathrm{m}\left(\mathrm{x}-x_1\right) $

$\Rightarrow \mathrm{y}+6=-1(\mathrm{x}+2) $

$\Rightarrow \mathrm{y}+6+\mathrm{x}+2=0 $

$\Rightarrow \mathrm{x}+\mathrm{y}+8=0 \ldots \ldots(i)$

B(6,6) বিন্দু হতে (i) নং রেখার লম্ব দুরত্ব,

$=\left|\frac{6+6+8}{\sqrt{1^2+1^2}}\right| $

$ =\frac{20}{\sqrt{2}} $

$ =10 \sqrt{2}$একক

questions.question: দেখাও যে, কোণ<B এর সমদ্বিখণ্ডকদ্বয় পরস্পর লম্ব।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, A(–2, –6), B(6, 6) এবং C(–6, –2)

B এর সমদ্বিখন্ডকদ্বয় যথাক্রমে AB ও BC

AB রেখার সমীকরণ,

$\frac{x+2}{-2-6}=\frac{y+6}{-6-6} $

$\Rightarrow \frac{x+2}{8}=\frac{y+6}{12} $

$\Rightarrow 12 x+24=8 y+48 $

$\Rightarrow 12 x-8 y-24=0 $

$\Rightarrow 3 x-2 y-6=0 ..... (i)$

BC রেখার সমীকরণ,

$\frac{x-6}{6+6}=\frac{y-6}{6+2} $

$\Rightarrow \frac{x-6}{12}=\frac{y-6}{8}$

$\Rightarrow 8 x-48=12 y-72 $

$\Rightarrow 8 x-12 y+24=0 $

$\Rightarrow 2 x-3 y+6=0 \ldots (ii)$

(i) ও (ii) নং রেখার মধ্যবর্তী কোণের সমদ্বিখন্ডকের সমীকরণ,

$\frac{2 x-3 y+6}{\sqrt{2^3+3^3}}= \pm \frac{3 x-2 y-6}{\sqrt{3^2+2^2}} $

$\Rightarrow 2 x-3 y+6= \pm(3 x-2 y-6)$

(+) নিয়ে পাই,$ 2 x-3 y+6=3 x-2 y-6 $

$\Rightarrow 2 x-3 y+6-3 x+2 y+6=0 $

$\Rightarrow -x-y+12=0 $

$\Rightarrow x+y-12=0 \ldots \ldots (iii)$

(-) নিয়ে পাই,$ 2 x-3 y+6=-3 x+2 y+6 $

$\Rightarrow 2 x-3 y+6+3 x-2 y-6=0 $

$\Rightarrow 5 x-5 y=0 \ldots (iv)$

(iii) নং রেখার ঢাল,  

$\mathrm{x}+\mathrm{y}-12=0 $

$\Rightarrow \mathrm{y}--\mathrm{x}+12 $

$\mathrm{~m}_1=-1$

(iv) নং রেখার ঢাল,

$ 5 x-5 y=0 $

$\Rightarrow 5 y=5 x $

$\Rightarrow y=x $

$\mathrm{~m}_2-1 $

ঢালদ্বয়ের গুণফল -1

সূতরাং রেখাদ্বয় পরস্পর লম্ব।

অতএব $\angle B$ এর সমদ্বিখন্ডক পরস্পর লম্ব।

questions.question: $(2,2)$ বিন্দু $x^2+y^2+4 x-2 y+4=0$ বৃত্তে অঙ্কিত স্পর্শকের দৈর্ঘ্য নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
$(2,2)$ বিন্দু হতে, $x^2+y^2+4 x-2 y+4=0$ বৃত্তে অঙ্কিত স্পর্শকের দৈর্ঘ্য

$\begin{aligned}& =\sqrt{2^2+2^2+4 \cdot 2-2 \cdot 2+4} \\& =\sqrt{16}\end{aligned}$

questions.question: উদ্দীপক-১ এ উল্লিখিত AB এর সমীকরণ নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
মনেকরি, AB রেখার সমীকরণ,

$\begin{aligned} & \frac{x}{a}+\frac{y}{b}=1 \ldots \ldots \ldots \ldots(i) \\ & \triangle O A B \text { এর ক্ষেত্রফল }==\frac{1}{2} a b \\ & \frac{1}{2} a b=\frac{32}{\sqrt{3}} \\ & \Rightarrow a b=\frac{64}{\sqrt{3}} \ldots \ldots . . . . .(\mathrm{ii}) \\ & \Rightarrow A O P=60^{\circ}=30^{\circ} \\ & \therefore \angle O A P=\angle O A B=90^{\circ}-60^{\circ}=30^{\circ} . \\ & \text { এখন, } \tan 30^{\circ}=\frac{O B}{O A^{\circ}}=\frac{b}{a} \\ & \Rightarrow \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}=\frac{b}{a} \\ & \Rightarrow a=\sqrt{3} b\end{aligned}$

(ii) নং এ a এর মান বসিয়ে পাই,

$\begin{aligned}& \mathrm{b} \sqrt{3}=\frac{69}{\sqrt{3}} \\& \Rightarrow \mathrm{b}^2=\frac{64}{3} \\& \Rightarrow \mathrm{b}= \pm \frac{8}{\sqrt{3}} \\& b=\frac{8}{\sqrt{3}} \text { [যেহ্তে ১ম চতুভাগে] }\end{aligned}$

(ii) নং হতে পাই,

$\begin{aligned}a b & =\frac{64}{\sqrt{3}} \\\Rightarrow a & =\frac{64}{\sqrt{3}} \times \frac{\sqrt{3}}{8} \\& =8\end{aligned}$

(1) নং সমীকরণে a ও b এর মান বসিয়ে,

$\begin{aligned}& \frac{x}{8}+\frac{y}{\frac{8}{\sqrt{3}}}=1 \\& \Rightarrow \quad \frac{x}{8}+\frac{y \sqrt{3}}{8}=-1 \\& \Rightarrow \quad x+\sqrt{3} y=8\end{aligned}$

ইহাই নির্ণেয় সমীকরণ।

questions.question: উদ্দীপক-২ এ উল্লিখিত বৃত্তদ্বয়ের সাধারণ জ্যাকে ব্যাস ধরে অঙ্কিত বৃত্তের সমীকরণ নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,

$\begin{array}{r}x^2+y^2+4 x+4 y+1=0 \\\text { এবং } x^2+y^2+4 x+3 y+2=0\end{array}$

বৃত্তদ্বয়ের সাধারণ জ্যা এর সমীকরণ,

 (i) - (ii)

$\therefore y-1=0 ........... (iii) $(i) নং বৃত্ত ও (iii) নং জ্যা এর ছেদবিন্দুগামী বৃত্তের সমীকরণ,

$\begin{aligned}& \mathrm{x}^2+\mathrm{y}^2+4 \mathrm{x}+1+\mathrm{k}(\mathrm{y}-1)=0-\text { (iv) } \\\Rightarrow & \mathrm{x}^2+\mathrm{y}^2+2 \cdot 2 \mathrm{x}+2 \cdot \frac{1}{2}(4+\mathrm{k}) \mathrm{y}+1-\mathrm{k}=0 \\\therefore \quad & \text { বৃর্তিটি কেন্দ্র }\left(-2, \frac{-4-\mathrm{k}}{2}\right)\end{aligned}$

(iv) নং বৃত্তের কেন্দ্র $\left(-2, \frac{-4-\mathrm{k}}{2}\right)$ বিন্দুটি জ্যা এর উপর অবস্থিত।

$\begin{aligned}& \therefore \frac{-4-\mathrm{k}}{2}-1=0 \\& \Rightarrow 4+\mathrm{k}+2=0 \\& \Rightarrow \mathrm{k}=-6\end{aligned}$

k এর মান (iv) নং এ বসিয়,

$\begin{aligned}& x^2+y^2+4 x+4 y+1-6(y-1)=0 \\\Rightarrow \quad & x^2+y^2+4 x+4 y+1-6 y+6=0 \\\Rightarrow \quad & x^2+y^2+4 x-2 y+7=0\end{aligned}$

questions.answer:

$f(x)=\sin x$

আমরা জানি, $A+B+C=\pi$

$\begin{aligned}& \therefore f(A)=\sin A \\&=\sin \{\pi-(B+C)\} \\&=\sin (B+C) \\& \begin{array}{cl}f(A) & =\sin B \cos C+\cos B \sin C\end{array} \text { (showed) }\end{aligned}$

questions.question: প্রমাণ কর যে, $C(\cos B-\cos A)=2(a-b) \cdot \cos ^2 \frac{c}{2}$
questions.answer:
$\triangle \mathrm{ABC} \Theta \mathrm{A}+\mathrm{B}+\mathrm{C}=\pi$

এবং $\frac{a}{\sin A}=\frac{b}{\sin B}=\frac{c}{\sin C}=2 R$

R.H.S $=2(a-b) \cdot \cos ^2 \frac{c}{2}$

$=2 \mathrm{C} \frac{\mathrm{a}-\mathrm{b}}{\mathrm{C}} \cdot \cos ^2 \frac{\mathrm{C}}{2}$

$=2 \mathrm{C} \frac{2 \mathrm{R} \sin \mathrm{A}-2 \mathrm{R} \sin \mathrm{B}}{2 \mathrm{R} \sin \mathrm{C}} \cdot \cos ^2 \frac{\mathrm{C}}{2}$

$=2 \mathrm{C} \frac{\sin \mathrm{A}-\sin \mathrm{B}}{\sin \mathrm{C}} \cdot \cos ^2 \frac{\mathrm{C}}{2}$

$=2 C \cdot \frac{2 \cos \frac{A+B}{2} \cdot \sin \frac{A-B}{2}}{2 \sin \frac{C}{2} \cdot \cos \frac{C}{2}} \cdot \cos ^2 \frac{C}{2}$

$=2 C \cdot \frac{2 \cos \left(\frac{\pi-C}{2}\right) \sin \frac{A-B}{2}}{2 \sin \frac{C}{2} \cdot \cos \frac{C}{2}} \cdot \cos ^2 \frac{C}{2}$

$=2 C \frac{\sin \frac{C}{2} \cdot \sin \frac{A-B}{2}}{\sin \frac{C}{2}} \cos \frac{C}{2}$

$=2 C \cdot \sin \frac{A-B}{2} \cdot \cos \frac{\pi-(A+B)}{2}$

$=2 C \cdot \sin \frac{A-B}{2} \cdot \sin \frac{A+B}{2}$

$=\mathrm{C}(\cos \mathrm{B}-\cos \mathrm{A})$

= L. H. S (Proved)

questions.question: প্রমাণ কর যে, f(A+B-C) + f(B+C-A) + f(C+A-B) = 4 sinA sinB sinC.
questions.answer:
প্রামণ কর যে,

$f(A+B-C)+f(B+C-A)+f(C+A-B)=4 \sin A \sin B \sin C$

দেওয়া আছে,

$\begin{aligned}& f(x)=\sin x \\& \mathrm{~L} \cdot \mathrm{H} \cdot \mathrm{s}=\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{A}+\mathrm{B}-\mathrm{C})+\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{B}+\mathrm{C}-\mathrm{A})+\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{C}+\mathrm{A}-\mathrm{B}) \\&= \sin (\mathrm{A}+\mathrm{B}-\mathrm{C})+\sin (\mathrm{B}+\mathrm{C}-\mathrm{A})+\sin (\mathrm{C}+\mathrm{A}-\mathrm{B}) \\&= \sin (\pi-2 \mathrm{C})+\sin (1 \pm 2 \mathrm{~A})+\sin (\mathrm{H}-2 \mathrm{~B}) \\&= \sin 2 \mathrm{C}+\sin 2 \mathrm{~A}+\sin 2 \mathrm{~B} \\&= 2 \sin (2 \mathrm{C}+2 \mathrm{~A}) \cdot \cos \left(\frac{2 \mathrm{C}-2 \mathrm{~A}}{2}\right)+\sin 2 \mathrm{~B} \\&= 2 \sin (\mathrm{C}+\mathrm{A}) \cdot \cos (\mathrm{C}-\mathrm{A})+\sin 2 \mathrm{~B} \\ &= 2 \sin (\pi-\mathrm{B}) \cdot \cos (\mathrm{C}-\mathrm{A})+\sin 2 \mathrm{~B} \\ &= 2 \sin \mathrm{B} \cdot \cos (\mathrm{C}-\mathrm{A})+2 \sin \mathrm{B} \cdot \cos \mathrm{B} \\ &= 2 \sin \mathrm{B}[\cos (\mathrm{C}-\mathrm{A})+\cos \mathrm{B}] \\ &= 2 \sin \mathrm{B}[\cos (\mathrm{C}-\mathrm{A})+\cos (\mathrm{H}-(\mathrm{C}+\mathrm{A})] \\ &= 2 \sin \mathrm{B}[-\cos (\mathrm{C}+\mathrm{A})+\cos (\mathrm{C}-\mathrm{A}] \\ &= 2 \sin \mathrm{B}[\cos (\mathrm{C}-\mathrm{A})-\cos (\mathrm{C}+\mathrm{A}] \\ &= 2 \sin \mathrm{B} \cdot 2 \sin \mathrm{C} \cdot \sin \mathrm{A} \\ &= 4 \sin \mathrm{A} \cdot \sin \mathrm{B} \cdot \sin \mathrm{C} \end{aligned}$

R. H. S

$\therefore \mathrm{f}(\mathrm{A}+\mathrm{B}-\mathrm{C})+\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{B}+\mathrm{C}-\mathrm{A})+\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{C}+\mathrm{A}-\mathrm{B})=\sin (A-B)=4 \sin A \cdot \sin B \cdot \sin C$

questions.question: x এর সাপেক্ষে p(x) এর অন্তরজ নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, 

$\begin{aligned} \mathrm{p}(\mathrm{x}) & =\left(\mathrm{x}^2+1\right) \tan ^{-1} \mathrm{x}-\mathrm{x} \\ \Rightarrow \frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{dx}} \mathrm{p}(\mathrm{x}) & =\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{dx}}\left(\mathrm{x}^2+1\right) \tan ^{-1} \mathrm{x}-\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{dx}} \mathrm{x} \\ & =\left(\mathrm{x}^2+1\right) \cdot \frac{1}{1+\mathrm{x}^2}+\tan ^{-1} \mathrm{x} \cdot(2 \mathrm{x})-1 \\ & =1+2 \mathrm{x} \cdot \tan ^{-1} \mathrm{x}-1 \\ & =2 \mathrm{xtan}^{-1} \mathrm{x}\end{aligned}$

questions.question: প্রমাণ কর যে, $\lim _{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{h(0)-2 h(x)+h(2 x)}{x^2}=-1$
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $h (x) = cosx$

$\begin{aligned}\text { L.H.S } & =\lim _{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{h(0)-2 h(x)+\cos 2 x}{x^2} \\& =\lim _{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{\cos x-2 \cos x+\cos 2 x}{x^2} \\& =\lim _{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{1+\cos 2 x-2 \cos x}{x^2} \\& =\lim _{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{2 \cos x^2 x-2 \cos x}{x^2} \\& =\lim _{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{-2 \cos x(1-\cos x)}{x^2} \\& =\lim _{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{-2 \cos x \cdot 2 \sin ^2 \frac{x}{2}}{x^2} \\& =-4 \lim _{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{\cos x \cdot \lim _x \frac{x}{2}}{x^2} \\& =-4 \cos 0 \cdot \lim _{\frac{x}{2} \rightarrow \sigma}\left(\frac{\sin \frac{x}{2}}{2}\right)^2 \cdot \frac{1}{4} \\& =-4 \cdot 1 \cdot 1^2 \cdot \frac{1}{4} \\& =-1\end{aligned}$

questions.question: $\sqrt{3} h\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-x\right)+3 h(x)$ এর চরম মান নির্ণয় কর?
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\mathrm{h}(\mathrm{x})=\cos \mathrm{x}$

$\begin{aligned}& \text { ধরি , } y=\sqrt{3} h\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-x\right)+3 h(x) \\ & \Rightarrow \mathrm{y}=\sqrt{3} \cos \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\mathrm{x}\right)+3 \cos \mathrm{x} \\ & \Rightarrow \mathrm{y}=\sqrt{3} \sin \mathrm{x}+3 \cos \mathrm{x} \\ & \Rightarrow \mathrm{y}^{\prime}=\sqrt{3} \cos \mathrm{x}-3 \sin \mathrm{x} \\ & \Rightarrow \mathrm{y}^{\prime \prime}=-\sqrt{3} \sin \mathrm{x}-3 \cos \mathrm{x} \end{aligned}$

চরম মানের জন্য,

$\begin{aligned}& f^{\prime}(x)=0 \\& \Rightarrow \quad \sqrt{3} \cos x-3 \sin x=0 \\& \Rightarrow \quad 3 \sin x=\sqrt{3} \cos x \\& \Rightarrow \quad \frac{\sin x}{\cos x}=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{3}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} \\& \Rightarrow \quad \tan x=\tan 30^{\circ} \\& \quad \tan x=\tan \left(180^{\circ}+30^{\circ}\right) \\& \therefore \quad x=30^{\circ}, 210^{\circ} \\& \mathrm{f}^{\prime \prime}\left(30^{\circ}\right) \quad-\sqrt{3} \sin 30^{\circ}-3 \cos 30^{\circ} \\&=-\sqrt{3} \cdot \frac{1}{2}-3 \cdot \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \\&=-\frac{4 \sqrt{3}}{2} \\&=-2 \sqrt{3}<0\end{aligned}$

$x=30^{\circ}$ এর জন্য $f(x)$ এর গুরুমান বিদ্যামন।

আবার,

$\begin{aligned} \mathrm{f}^{\prime \prime}\left(210^{\circ}\right) & =-\sqrt{3} \sin 2 \times 0^{\circ} 2-3 \cos 210^{\circ} \\ & =-\sqrt{3} \sin \left(180^{\circ}+30^{\circ}\right)-3 \cos \left(180^{\circ}+30^{\circ}\right) \\ & \left.=-\sqrt{3}\left(-\sin 30^{\circ}\right)-3 \cos 30^{\circ}\right) 12 \\ & =-\sqrt{3} \cdot\left(-\frac{1}{2}\right)-3 \cdot\left(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right) \\ & =\frac{4 \sqrt{3}}{2}=2 \sqrt{3}>0\end{aligned}$

$x=210^{\circ}$ এর জন্য $f(x)$ এর লঘুমান বিদ্যামান।

$\begin{aligned} \mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x}) \text { এর লঘুমান= } & =\mathrm{f}\left(210^{\circ}\right) \\ & =\sqrt{3} \sin 210^{\circ}+3 \cos 210^{\circ} \\ & =\sqrt{3}\left(-\frac{1}{2}\right)+3\left(-\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right) \\ & =-\frac{4 \sqrt{3}}{2}=-2 \sqrt{3}\end{aligned}$

questions.question: $\frac{d^2 y}{d x^2}$ নির্ণয় কর?
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,

$\begin{aligned}& y=x+\frac{1}{x} \\\Rightarrow & \frac{d y}{d x}=1-\frac{1}{x^2} \\\Rightarrow & \frac{d^2 y}{d x^2}=-\frac{(-2)}{x^3} \\\therefore & \frac{d^2 y}{d x^2}=\frac{2}{x^3}\end{aligned}$

questions.question: প্রমাণ কর যে, $\cos ^4\left\{\cot ^{-1} \sqrt{\frac{1-g(x)}{1+g(x)}}\right\}=\frac{1}{2}(x-1)$
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $g(x)=x$

ধরি, $ y=\cos ^4\left\{\cot ^{-1} \sqrt{\frac{1-g(x)}{1+g(x)}}\right\} $
$ = \cos ^4\left\{\cot ^{-1} \sqrt{\frac{1-x}{1+x}}\right\} $
$ =\cos ^4\left\{\cot ^{-1} \sqrt{\frac{1-\cos \theta}{1+\cos \theta}}\right\}     $ধরি,$ x=\cos \theta $
$ =\cos ^4\left\{\cot ^{-1} \sqrt{\frac{2 \sin ^2 \frac{\theta}{2}}{2 \cos ^2 \frac{\theta}{2}}}\right\} $
$ =\cos ^4\left\{\cot ^{-1}\left(\tan \frac{\theta}{2}\right)\right\}=\cos ^4\left\{\cot ^{-1} \cot \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\frac{\theta}{2}\right)\right\} $
$ =\cos ^4\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\frac{\theta}{2}\right)=\sin ^4 \frac{\theta}{2}=\frac{1}{4}\left\{2 \sin ^2 \frac{\theta}{2}\right\}^2=\frac{1}{4}(1-\cos \theta)^2 $
$ =\frac{1}{4}(1-x)^2[\because \cos \theta=\mathrm{x}] $
$ \therefore \quad y=\frac{1}{4}(x-1)^2 $
$ \therefore \quad \frac{d y}{d x}=\frac{d}{d x} \frac{1}{4}(x-1)^2=\frac{1}{4} \cdot 2(x-1) \cdot 1=\frac{1}{2}(x-1) $
$ \therefore \frac{d}{d x}\left[\cos ^4\left\{\cot ^{-1} \sqrt{\frac{1-g(x)}{1+g(x)}}\right\}\right]=\frac{1}{2}(x-1) . $ (প্রমাণিত)

questions.question: $y=\sqrt{4+3 g(\sin x)}$ হলে, দেখাও যে, $2 y y_2+2 y_1^2+y^2-4=0$
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,

$\begin{aligned} & g(x)=x \\ & y=\sqrt{4+3 g(\sin x)} \\ & \Rightarrow y^2=4+3 g(\sin x) \\ & \Rightarrow y^2=4+3 \sin x \\ & \Rightarrow \frac{d}{d x} y^2=\frac{d}{d x}(4+3 \sin x) \\ & \Rightarrow \quad 2 y \cdot y_1=3 \cos x \\ & \Rightarrow \frac{d}{d x}\left(2 y_1\right)=\frac{d}{d x}(3 \cos x) \\ & \Rightarrow 2 \cdot\left(y \cdot y_2+y_1 \cdot y_1\right)=-3 \sin x \\ & \Rightarrow q y_2+2 y_1^2=-3 \sin x \\ & \text { এখন, } 2 \mathrm{yy}_1+2 \mathrm{y}_1^2+\mathrm{y}^2-4=-3 \sin \mathrm{x}+\mathrm{y}^2-4 \\ & \Rightarrow 2 \mathrm{yy}_1+2 \mathrm{y}_1^2+\mathrm{y}^2-4=-3 \sin \mathrm{x}+4+3 \sin \mathrm{x}-4 \\ & =0(\text { poved }) \\ & \end{aligned}$

questions.question: $\int \frac{h^{\prime}(x)}{\{1+h(x)\}^2} d x$ নির্ণয় কর?
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,

$\begin{aligned}\mathrm{h}(\mathrm{x}) & =\tan \mathrm{x} \\\mathrm{h}^{\prime}(\mathrm{x}) & =\sec ^2 \mathrm{x}\end{aligned}$

let, $\tan x=z$

$\Rightarrow \sec ^2 x d x=d z$

$\begin{aligned}& \int \frac{h^{\prime}(x)}{\{1+h(x)\}^2} d x \\= & \int \frac{\sec ^2 x}{(1+\tan x)^2} d x \\= & \int \frac{d z}{(1+z)^2} \\= & \frac{(1+z)^{-2+1}}{-2+1}+c \\= & -\frac{1}{1+z^2}+c=-\frac{1}{1+\tan x}+c\end{aligned}$

questions.question: $\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}} \frac{30 h^{\prime}(x) d x}{\left[\{h(x)\}^2-\right]\{h(x)-2\}}$ এর মান নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,

$\begin{aligned}& h(x)=\tan x \\& h^{\prime}(x)=\sec ^2 x d x\end{aligned}$

প্রদত্ত রাশি,

$\begin{aligned}& \int_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}} \frac{30 \mathrm{~h}^{\prime}(\mathrm{x}) \mathrm{dx}}{\left[\{\mathrm{h}(\mathrm{x})\}^2-9\right]\{\mathrm{h}(\mathrm{x})-2\}} \\& =\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}} \frac{3 \sec ^2 x d x}{\left(\tan ^2 x-9\right)(\tan x-2)}\end{aligned}$

$\begin{aligned} & =\int_0^1 \frac{30 d y}{\left(y^2-9\right)(y-2)} \\ & =30 \int_0^1 \frac{1 d y}{(y+3)(y-3)(y-2)} \\ & =30 \int_0^1\left[\frac{1}{(y+3)(-3-3)(-3-2)}+\frac{1}{(y-3)(3+3)(3-2)}+\frac{1}{(y-2)(2+3)(2-3)}\right] d y \\ & =30 \int_0^1\left[\frac{1}{30(y+3)}+\frac{1}{6(y-3)}-\frac{1}{5(y-2)}\right] d y \\ & \left.=[\ln (y+z)]_0^1+5[\ln (y-3)]\right]_0-6[\ln (y-2)]_0^1 \\ & =\ln 4-\ln 3+5[(n|-2|-\ln |-3|]-16[|n|+||-\ln |-2|] \\ & =\ln \frac{4}{3}+5 \ln \frac{2}{3}-6 \ln \frac{1}{2} \\ & =\ln \frac{4}{3}+\ln \left(\frac{2}{3}\right)^5-\ln \left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^6 \\ & =\ln \left(\frac{4}{3} \times\left(\frac{2}{3}\right)^5 \div \frac{1}{2^6}\right) \\ & =\ln \left(\frac{4}{3} \times\left(\frac{2}{5}\right)^5 \times 2^6\right) \\ & =\ln \frac{2^{13}}{3^6} \\ & =\ln 2^{13}-\ln 3^6 \\ & =13 \ln 2-6 \ln 3 \\ & \end{aligned}$

questions.question: যোগজীকরণের সাহয্যে $f(x, y)=36$ দ্বারা আবদ্ধ ক্ষেত্রের ক্ষেত্রফল নির্ণয় কর?
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে.

$ \begin{aligned} & f(x, y)=4 x^2+9 y^2 \\ & \therefore \quad 36=4 x^2+9 y^2 \\ & \Rightarrow \frac{4}{36} x^2+\frac{9}{36} y^2=\frac{36}{36} \\ & \Rightarrow \frac{x^2}{9}+\frac{y^2}{4}=1 \end{aligned}$

এখানে, $a=3, b=2$

আবদ্ধ ক্ষেত্রের ক্ষেত্রফল, $=4 \mathrm{x}$ এক চতর্থাংশের ক্ষেত্রফল,

$\text { এখন, } \begin{aligned}\frac{y^2}{4} & =1-\frac{x^2}{9} \\\Rightarrow \frac{y^2}{4} & =\frac{9-x^2}{9} \\\Rightarrow y^2 & =\frac{4}{9}\left(9-x^2\right)\end{aligned}$

$\begin{aligned} & \Rightarrow y=\sqrt{\frac{4}{9}\left(9-x^2\right)} \\ & =\frac{2}{3} \sqrt{\left(9-x^2\right)} \\ & \left.\therefore \int_0^a y d x=\frac{2}{3} \int_0^3 \sqrt{9-x^2} d x / 2\right) \\ & =\frac{2}{3}\left[\frac{x \sqrt{3^2-x^2}}{2}+\frac{9}{2} \sin ^{-1}\left(\frac{x}{3}\right)\right]_0^3 \\ & =\frac{2}{3}\left[0+\frac{9}{2} \sin ^{-1}\left(\frac{3}{2}\right)-(0+0)\right] \\ & =\frac{2}{3}\left[\frac{9}{2} \times \frac{\pi}{2}\right]^{20} \times 1= \\ & =\frac{3 \pi}{2} \\ & \therefore \text { আবদ্ধ ক্ষেত্রের ক্ষেত্রফল }=4 \times \frac{3 \pi}{2} \\ & =6 \pi \text { বর্গ একক }\end{aligned}$
